portInfo.description: North Sea gateway better known for Hook of Holland ferries than mega-ship volume — cruise calls exist but cruise-only annuals were not extracted. Old Harwich town is a separate hop from Parkeston.

gettingThere.fromTerminal: Harwich International Port — passenger / cruise facilities
gettingThere.distanceToCity: Rail station on site; towns need a short local hop — no invented minutes.
gettingThere.distanceAnswer: Rail station on site; towns need a short local hop — no invented minutes.
gettingThere.publicTransport: Confirm local transport options with the ship on your call date.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Do not confuse ferry embarkation flows with a leisure stroll into Old Harwich.
